MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Deck Plus screws felt relevant because I recently chose long wood and outdoor deck screws; they serve a similar fastening purpose.",
    "Their #10 size and 3-1/2-inch length are close to the #10 x 4-inch screws in my history, although I would still check the length my project requires."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Wire connectors and heat shrink tubing serve electrical tasks that my recent nails, wood screws, and drywall anchors do not establish a need for.",
    "Locking nuts and removable fasteners may also attach things, but they do not meet the same needs as screws driven into wood or anchors installed in drywall.",
    "The cutting wheels, seal tape, glow sticks, and alarm battery require specific tasks or equipment needs I have not shown."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in particular fastening supplies seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any repair or maintenance supply.",
    "Items seem to have been treated as interchangeable because they connect or secure things, even when their materials and uses differ."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of framing nails and wood screws make the fastening purpose, material, dimensions, and tool compatibility especially relevant.",
    "My medicine cups and vacuum bags reflect separate needs; they do not mean I am currently interested in unrelated maintenance products.",
    "Replacement supplies need to fit equipment I actually use, so an alarm battery is not compelling without evidence of compatibility."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my fastening interests but extended them too broadly beyond the wood and drywall tasks supported by my recent choices."
}
